verdict.rationale: Asana documents its own AI automation features: AI Studio is billed as 'powerful no-code automations', and pre-built and custom AI Teammates work inside real workflows using Work Graph context. That suggests AI could act on incoming work, but no item explicitly describes triaging or prioritizing incoming bugs or tasks. The API, webhooks, and MCP server are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-driven triage or prioritization of incoming work, how it handles bug intake, routing and priority-setting behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
